name: E4 európai hosszútávú turistaút (magyarországi szakasz)
description_md:
The E4 európai hosszútávú turistaút is a waymarked hiking route located in Hungary. This international waymarked hiking network trail covers a distance of 1722.4 km.

The route is signposted as E4 and involves 30191 m of ascent and 30427 m of descent. It is considered easy based on the distance and ascent, requiring about 511 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The path passes the Saint Martin Church in Hollókő and the Postal Museum in Hollókő within 100 m. It also passes the Attila József House of Culture within 200 m.
